title: Ability registry entry (bt_data.json abilities[], from tools/gen_bt_data.py --snapshot)
description: One unit flag, aura kind, weapon keyword, army-wide rule or hidden-unit flag with its Thai and English text. {v} in the text stands for the flag's value (e.g. rez 5 -> 'reanimates on a 5+'). core/battle/abilities.gd maps every key here to a handler.

key.description: flag name; aura kinds as aura:<kind>; army rules as the army code

value.description: what the datasheet stores under the key

applies.description: weapon keywords only: which weapon slot may carry it

th.description: Thai text as the page's abilityText / wpnLine shows it

en.description: English text as the server's bt2Abilities tells Claude
